spawn_spec.prompt: Perform a read-only acceptance audit in the shared rorca workspace. Do not edit files, run desktop apps, use OS input, or modify git/docs. Inspect the implemented nested split and numeric shortcut changes in TerminalSplitView, layout reducer, shortcuts, App, and their focused tests. Check whether each user requirement is represented: horizontal root preserved when adding vertical split, no PTY spawn, pane-local split actions are semantically correct, Cmd+1..4 selects workspace by index, Ctrl+1..4 selects tab by index, out-of-range is harmless, and existing modifiers/terminal typing remain protected. Write only .omo/evidence/rorca/interaction-source-audit.md with PASS/FAIL per item, precise source/test evidence, and any concrete gap. Use apply_patch and return the path.
